narrative: Course Coordinator sends an end-semester feedback survey notice.

message.body: The course feedback portal for CS301 is now open until next week. Please complete your evaluation on the student dashboard.

evidence.label: Official Student Dashboard
evidence.value: Dashboard displays active CS301 feedback banner.

consequence_text.safe: You confirmed the survey on your dashboard and submitted your course feedback safely.
consequence_text.unsafe: Reporting valid official notifications leads to over-caution and missed administrative tasks.

teaching_point: Verify authentic notices via your official dashboard without suspicion bias.
